item.title: [NVDA] Alibaba Chip Smuggling Allegations Raise Fresh Questions For AI Growth Narrative
item.description: US authorities are investigating a reported US$2.5b smuggling scheme involving advanced Nvidia chips shipped to China. The company has publicly denied any involvement or business relationship with the parties mentioned in the alleged scheme.
